releaseNotes: Today replaces Converter and shows items newly added to the phone today from MediaStore without rebuilding Smart Search or OCR indexes. Photos no longer shows the Albums / Folders strip on the main page; Years is moved up and presented as cleaner horizontal year cards. Real album create/move/rename behavior remains available, and the existing photo actions, auto-sync, themes, sounds, saved-index search, OCR payload, signing identity, and update flow are preserved.
